name: Emily Johnson
title: Quantum Computing
description: A type of computing that uses quantum-mechanical phenomena like superposition and entanglement. It can solve certain complex problems much faster than classical computers by processing many possibilities simultaneously.

name: Michael Smith
title: Machine Learning
description: A subset of AI that enables systems to learn and improve from experience without explicit programming. It uses algorithms to find patterns in data and make predictions or decisions.

name: Sarah Lee
title: Blockchain
description: A decentralized digital ledger that records transactions across many computers securely. Each block is linked to the previous one, making data immutable and transparent without a central authority.

name: David Kim
title: Augmented Reality
description: Technology that overlays digital content like images or information onto the real world through a camera or glasses. It enhances physical environments with interactive virtual elements in real-time.

name: Jessica Martinez
title: Internet of Things
description: A network of physical devices embedded with sensors and software to connect and exchange data over the internet. It enables smart homes, wearables, and industrial automation.

name: Daniel Brown
title: Edge Computing
description: Processing data near the source instead of in a central cloud server. It reduces latency, bandwidth usage, and improves real-time responses for applications like autonomous vehicles and smart cameras.

name: Sophia Garcia
title: Natural Language Processing
description: A branch of AI that helps computers understand, interpret, and generate human language. It powers chatbots, translation tools, and sentiment analysis by processing text or speech.

name: James Wilson
title: Cybersecurity
description: The practice of protecting systems, networks, and data from digital attacks, theft, or damage. It involves technologies like encryption, firewalls, and threat monitoring to ensure confidentiality.

name: Olivia Taylor
title: Deep Learning
description: A type of machine learning using multi-layered neural networks to model complex patterns. It excels at tasks like image recognition, speech processing, and autonomous driving with large datasets.

name: William Anderson
title: Serverless Computing
description: A cloud execution model where the provider manages server infrastructure. Developers deploy code as functions, paying only for actual usage without provisioning or scaling servers manually.
